compareDisposition.rationale: The curator examined Solomon asks heaven to hear toward the temple beside Abram leaves and receives a land promise; Promise passes through affliction and return; Covenant joins descendants and land; Isaac is told to remain in the land. Those passages share its Eden-and-exile evidence group or canonical movement, but none supplies a distinct two-source relationship stronger than the accepted comparisons already carrying this topic.
